routing_lesson: Complex full-ABI producers, as well as large oracles, should normally be routed as one real basic block, typed API, thin binding, finite source counterexample or mechanical fragment, with owner preserving whole orchestration. This does not forbid justified finite exploration of a genuinely new boundary.
